new_or_strengthened_atoms.claim: Frankenstein effect authority evolved through two incomplete but complementary lineages: historical Project-Frankenstein had real pre-execution denial but weak decision-to-execution binding; current stern.py has richer generation/idempotency/outcome journaling but deliberately nonblocking ordinary admission bookkeeping.

new_or_strengthened_atoms.claim: Historical approval_id correlates UI/workflow approval but is not mechanically consumed by ToolExecutor.execute(); no approved request digest, invocation identity, generation or one-shot execution lease is passed to the executor boundary.
skip_approval=True is caller-controlled authority in the historical executor path. It is acceptable as lineage evidence but must not survive as Frankenstein-2.0 real-effect authority.

Every state-changing call must carry an immutable invocation_id/tool_use_id successor plus canonical request_digest and generation from admission through enforcement, execution, outcome verification, completion and re-entry. Session identity is context, not a correlation key.

When human approval is required, the owner grant must be minted outside model text, scope-bound to the exact typed EffectRequest, short-lived and single-use, then consumed by deterministic enforcement. Human approval is not implied for every effect; policy decides when it is required.

The archived wache-koenig command classifier/ticket mechanism is useful as a destructive-command regression corpus and capability-lease donor, but Bash-only regex authority cannot be promoted to the complete EntityOS effect boundary.

hard_rules: No caller-controlled skip_approval bypass in the successor authority path.
No mutable session-wide current-effect pointer as the sole invocation correlation key.

Post-submission transport uncertainty becomes OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, not cancellation success and not blind replay.
Journal status labels are not enforcement decisions unless bound to the exact enforcement receipt.
Model, Voice and GRID outputs may propose EffectRequest only; deterministic control consumes authority.
